title: Vice's Bloxy Hat!
description: A resource pack that implements the Bloxy Hat from the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards as a hat in-game.
body:
This resource pack implements the Bloxy Hat from the 7th Annual Bloxy Awards. 

In order to acquire the hat by default, run the following command (as of 1.20.5):

```
/give @s minecraft:carved_pumpkin[minecraft:custom_model_data=1]
```


Feel free to make changes to the pack as you please, I simply wanted to share this to ya'll.
